column1: # decision-phrasings.tsv -- the closed list of phrasings that mark a decision
# asked of a person, or a question addressed to one. One list, read by
# progress-view.sh (--next text and needs), report-questions.sh (a worker's
# report) and need-check.sh (a surfaced need), through record-common.sh's
# lib_phrase_match. It is a backstop: a decision row comes only from an
# escalated entry, and rewording evades any list.
#   kind     decision   the text asks someone to decide
#            addressed  the text addresses a person rather than the coordinator
#   pattern  an extended regular expression, matched case-insensitively by
#            grep -E; no back-references, so matching time stays linear
# Adding a row: add a fixture beside it in
